Complete the following statements
9 of 15 points
Complete the following statements by choosing ALL that is applicable from the options below.


Tip: Read the statements slowly and clearly whilst understanding the scenario. Then search for the rule in your notes, confirm it and then respond.

1. The مفعول له is...
*
1/1
...an إسم.
 
...a حرف.
...a فعل.

2. The مفعول له which conforms to its conditions is...
*
1/1
...منصوب.
 
...مجرور.
...مرفوع.

3. The مفعول له signifes...
*
1/1
...the reason for an action being conducted.
 
...the time an action is conducted in.
...the place an action is conducted in.
...the method an action is conducted in.

4. A valid مفعول له will...
*
1/1
...be an interpreted masdar.
....sync in time with action.
 
...will be related to the فاعل and nothing else.
 
...will be related to the فاعل and the مفعول به.
...be a clear masdar.

5. If one of the مفعول له conditions are not present, then...
*
1/1
...a لام will be assumed.
 
...it will become a grammatically incorrect construction.
...nothing will be assumed and it will become a haal.
...a باء will be assumed.

6. The مفعول له ...
*
1/1
...can come after the verb.
 
...must come before the verb.
...must come after the verb.
...can come before the verb.

7. The مفعول فيه is...
*
1/1
...an إسم.
 
...a فعل.
...a حرف.

8. The مفعول فيه can be...
*
0/1
...منصوب.
 
...مرفوع.
...مجرور.
Correct answer
...منصوب.
...مجرور.

9. The مفعول فيه signifes...
*
0/1
...the place an action is conducted in.
 
...the reason for an action being conducted.
...the time an action is conducted in.
...the method an action is conducted in.
Correct answer
...the time an action is conducted in.
...the place an action is conducted in.

10. The مفعول فيه ...
*
1/1
...can come after the verb.
 
...can come before the verb.
 
...must come before the verb.
...must come after the verb.

11. The مفعول فيه will require an explicit في...
*
0/1
...If the مفعول فيه is a restricted ظرف زمان.
 
...If the مفعول فيه is a restricted ظرف مكان.
 
...If the مفعول فيه is an unrestricted ظرف زمان.
...If the مفعول فيه is an unrestricted ظرف مكان.
Correct answer
...If the مفعول فيه is a restricted ظرف مكان.

12. The غايات are...
*
1/1
...unrestricted ظروف
 
...restricted ظروف

13.  The غايات are called  غايات because...
*
0/1
...they become مبني when their مضاف إليه is dropped.
 
...the sentence ends with them.
...the word ends with them.
...they remain معرب when their مضاف إليه is dropped.
...they don't accept تنوين العوض.
 
Correct answer
...the word ends with them.
...they don't accept تنوين العوض.

14. A تنوين العوض compensates...
*
0/1
...a dropped sentence.
...a dropped حرف like مِنْ.
...a dropped word.
 
...a dropped letter
...a hidden word like ثابت.
Correct answer
...a dropped letter
...a dropped word.
...a dropped sentence.

15. The tanween on the following word is...
*
0/1
...a تنوين العوض (a tanween of compensation).
...a تنوين التنكير (a tanween of indefiniteness).
 
...a تنوين التمكين (a tanween of firm establishment).
Correct answer
...a تنوين التمكين (a tanween of firm establishment).
